steps.hint: Super + Space is the front door: apps, settings, everything. Press Escape to close it again.
steps.why: When you forget a shortcut, this menu is where you look.

steps.hint: Super + Return (Enter) opens a new terminal window.
steps.why: Omarchy is terminal-first. This is the shortcut you'll press most.

steps.hint: Add Shift to Super + Return and you get the browser instead.
steps.why: Shift on a launch shortcut usually means 'the other one'.

steps.hint: Super + K lists every shortcut with a search box. Escape closes it.
steps.why: You never need to memorize everything: Super + K is the cheat sheet built into the desktop.

steps.hint: Click the practice window first so it has focus, then Super + W.
steps.why: W for window. It's the only close shortcut Omarchy 4 ships.

steps.hint: Super + Escape: lock, suspend, restart, shut down. Escape again to back out.
steps.why: Everything about leaving the machine lives here.
